note: For these historical estimates, we rely on data based on the NASA MCD64 MODIS sensor, which, according to the data provider, might underestimate burnt areas and fire occurrences.
title: Wildfire area burned by land cover type
subtitle: Total area of land that was burned as a result of [wildfires](#dod:wildfires) each year. This captures all vegetation burning of a certain size; some planned and agricultural burns are captured, however a lot of cropland burning is too small-scale to detect with satellites.
